description: [$0.002] Fast live web search & news JSON (up to 5 batched queries, highlights, sentiment, entities). Also serves drop-in POST /v1/search. $0.002/call — 2.5x-5x cheaper than Exa ($0.004-$0.007). Do not use for single-URL extraction (use web_fetch_markdown) or crypto ticker feeds (use news_crypto_feed). `q` and `query` are aliases, `queries` overrides them for up to 5 batched lookups (1 HTTP request), and omitting all returns top headlines. Live web/RSS data, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 60 HTTP req/min.

category.description: Filter by category: web or news

fields.description: Return only these result keys, e.g. ["title","url","enrichment.sentiment"]

limit.description: Max results to return per query (default 50, max 500)

q.description: Search query — supports AI, crypto, finance, tech, biotech, energy topics

queries.description: Batch: array of up to 5 queries; priced unit price x count

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.
